tokens.name: dur-ring

easing.note: After Effects: out influence = x1 x 100, in influence = (1 - x2) x 100. Whistle: 20 and 80. Settle: 30 and 100.

tokens.name: ease-whistle
tokens.usage: Default. Fast start, soft landing.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Things that arrive and stay: sheets, panels.

tokens.name: ease-roll
tokens.usage: Things that leave or travel: the seed along the ring, fades out.
